title: BizDevOps: Aligning the Business and IT with a Graph Knowledge Base | Dave Duggal and Bill Malyk
description:
🔍 One Graph to Bind Them All: Revolutionary Approach to Business Operations | CDW 2021

Join Dave Duggal, founder and CEO of Enterprise Web, as he unveils a groundbreaking approach to managing complex business operations using graph technology. In this enlightening talk from CDW 2021, discover how Enterprise Web's innovative platform is transforming the way organizations handle distributed systems and data integration.

🔑 Key Highlights:
• Learn how graph technology can revolutionize business operations
• Discover a no-code solution for complex system integration
• See real-world applications with SAP integration
• Understand the power of graph-based system modeling

💡 Perfect for:
- Enterprise Architects
- Business Operations Leaders
- Technology Decision Makers
- Software Engineers
- System Integrators

🎯 This presentation offers practical insights into solving one of today's biggest business challenges: managing operations across fragmented systems, cloud services, and business partners.

Includes live demo showcasing real-world implementation!
